item.title: 2024 champion Pedro Cardoso joins G Racing Motorsport
item.description: 2024 TCR South America champion Pedro Cardoso has joined G Racing Motorsport for the 2026 season which starts this weekend. The Brazilian driver finished third overall last year while racing a Peugeot 308TCR for PMO Racing.
